entries.zh: 尚无车机屏幕，用固定分辨率
entries.en: No head unit display recorded; using a fixed resolution

entries.zh: 请把 iPad 旋转到所选方向以获得全屏画面
entries.en: Rotate the iPad to the selected orientation for full-screen video

entries.zh: 已读取保存的 Wi-Fi 配置
当前签名无法读取钥匙串（-34018）。请手动输入 Wi-Fi 密码，密码仅在本次 App 运行期间保留。
entries.en: The current signing profile cannot read Keychain (-34018). Enter the Wi-Fi password manually. It will be kept only while the app is running.

entries.zh: 无法读取已保存的密码，请重新输入。
entries.en: Cannot read the saved password. Enter it again.

entries.zh: 请在设置中添加或选择 Wi-Fi 预设。
entries.en: Add or select a Wi-Fi preset in Settings.

entries.zh: 让两台设备连接同一个 Wi-Fi。
entries.en: Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi network.

entries.zh: 可以手动填写 Wi-Fi 名称，也可允许定位后自动读取。
entries.en: Enter the Wi-Fi network name manually, or allow location access to read it automatically.

entries.zh: 无法读取 Wi-Fi 名称，请手动填写。
entries.en: Cannot read the Wi-Fi network name. Enter it manually.

entries.zh: 无法删除 Wi-Fi 预设：{1}
无法安全保存 Wi-Fi 密码，请重试。
entries.en: Cannot securely save the Wi-Fi password. Try again.

entries.zh: 请先停止 CarPlay，再测试本机传输。
entries.en: Stop CarPlay before testing local transport.

entries.zh: CoreAccessories 已创建并发布 protocol-4 iAP2 endpoint
entries.en: CoreAccessories created and published a protocol-4 iAP2 endpoint

entries.zh: success: CoreAccessories 已发布 protocol-4 iAP2 endpoint
entries.en: success: CoreAccessories published a protocol-4 iAP2 endpoint

entries.zh: 无法保存传输测试结果：{1}
entries.en: Cannot save the transport test result: {1}

entries.zh: MFi 身份验证通过并已保存到本机 Keychain
entries.en: MFi identity verified and saved to local Keychain

entries.zh: success: MFi 身份已验证并保存到 Keychain
entries.en: success: MFi identity verified and saved to Keychain

entries.zh: 已从 Keychain 载入 MFi 身份，ECDSA 自检通过
entries.en: MFi identity loaded from Keychain; ECDSA self-test passed

entries.zh: 已从内置资源载入 MFi 身份，ECDSA 自检通过
entries.en: MFi identity loaded from bundled resources; ECDSA self-test passed

请通过 Documents/IdentityImport 导入 certificate.p7b、leaf.cer 和 private.x963。错误：{1}
entries.en: Import certificate.p7b, leaf.cer, and private.x963 through Documents/IdentityImport. Error: {1}

entries.zh: 无法保存身份导入结果：{1}
entries.en: Cannot save the identity import result: {1}

entries.zh: 兼容信道请输入 1–196，或留空使用默认值 36。
entries.en: Enter a compatibility channel from 1 to 196, or leave it blank to use the default of 36.

entries.zh: 请输入 Wi-Fi 密码；开放网络请选择“无密码”。
entries.en: Enter the Wi-Fi password, or select “Open Network (No Password)” for an open network.

entries.zh: 请先选择 iPad 接收端，并确保两台设备位于同一 Wi-Fi。
entries.en: Select an iPad receiver first and make sure both devices are on the same Wi-Fi network.

entries.zh: 正在请求把本机 CarPlay 投送到 {1}（{2}:{3}）
entries.en: Requesting CarPlay projection from this iPhone to {1} ({2}:{3})
Cannot start CarPlay on this iPhone: {1}

entries.zh: 正在等待 iPhone 连接
正在等待 Wi-Fi 分配 IP 地址…
entries.en: Waiting for a Wi-Fi IP Address…

entries.zh: 未获得 Wi-Fi 地址。请连接正确的 Wi-Fi 后重试。
entries.en: No Wi-Fi address received. Connect to the correct Wi-Fi network and try again.

entries.zh: 启动期间 Wi-Fi 已切换或恢复，使用当前地址重新连接 CarPlay
entries.en: Wi-Fi changed or recovered during startup; reconnecting CarPlay using the current address

entries.zh: 需要导入 MFi 身份
连接较久时，可尝试在系统设置中关闭再打开 Wi-Fi。当前仍在继续连接。
entries.en: If connection takes a long time, try turning Wi-Fi off and on in system Settings. Connection attempts are still continuing.

entries.zh: 选择一台 iPad，把这台 iPhone 的 CarPlay 投送到它的屏幕。
entries.en: Select an iPad to display this iPhone’s CarPlay on its screen.

entries.zh: 无需外接盒子，直接在这台 iPhone 上启动并显示 CarPlay。
entries.en: Start and display CarPlay directly on this iPhone without an external adapter.

entries.zh: 接收另一台 iPhone 的导航、音乐和触控画面。
entries.en: Receive navigation, music, and an interactive CarPlay display from another iPhone.

entries.zh: 让 iPhone 和 iPad 连接同一个 Wi-Fi。
entries.en: Connect the iPhone and iPad to the same Wi-Fi network.

entries.zh: 先在系统设置连接 Wi-Fi，再在 CarWithin 选择对应预设。
entries.en: Connect to Wi-Fi in system Settings first, then select the matching preset in CarWithin.

entries.zh: 先启动此接收屏，再从另一台 iPhone 发起连接。
entries.en: Start this receiver first, then connect from another iPhone.

entries.zh: 本次连接已自动重启 2 次，不再重启：{1}
entries.en: Already restarted automatically twice this session; no further restart: {1}

entries.zh: 正在按新的画面设置重启 CarPlay…
entries.en: Restarting CarPlay with the New Video Settings…

entries.zh: 后台保持在进入后台时重试成功
entries.en: Background keep-alive retry succeeded when entering the background

entries.zh: App 已进入后台，CarPlay 继续运行
entries.en: App entered the background; CarPlay continues running

entries.zh: App 已进入后台，由画中画保持运行
entries.en: App entered the background; Picture in Picture is keeping it running

entries.zh: App 已进入后台且没有画中画或后台保持，iOS 会挂起 App，已停止 CarPlay
entries.en: App entered the background without Picture in Picture or background keep-alive. iOS will suspend the app; CarPlay stopped

entries.zh: 修改地址或证书后，重新启动 CarPlay 生效。
entries.en: Restart CarPlay after changing the address or certificate.

entries.zh: CarPlay 运行中，停止后才能修改这些设置。
entries.en: CarPlay is running. Stop it before changing these settings.

entries.zh: 路由器、车机 Wi-Fi 或另一台手机的热点都可以。有网、没网都能投屏。运行 CarWithin 的 iPhone 需要实际加入 Wi-Fi，自己开热点不能代替这一步。
entries.en: Use a router, the head unit’s Wi-Fi, or another phone’s hotspot. Screen projection works with or without internet access. The iPhone running CarWithin must join a Wi-Fi network; turning on its own Personal Hotspot does not replace this step.

entries.zh: 回到 CarWithin，在「Wi-Fi 预设」选择刚连的网络。第一次用，在「Wi-Fi 与网络」添加。
entries.en: Return to CarWithin and select the network you just joined under “Wi-Fi Presets”. For first-time use, add it under “Wi-Fi & Network”.

entries.zh: 车机连同一个 Wi-Fi。在「当前输出」选浏览器，启动 CarPlay，再用车机打开首页显示的 HTTP 地址。
entries.en: Connect the head unit to the same Wi-Fi network. Choose Browser under “Current Output”, start CarPlay, then open the HTTP address shown on the home screen from the head unit.

entries.zh: 使用仪表时先加入仪表 Wi-Fi，再按首页连接卡的顺序操作。CarLife 先打开车机上的 CarLife；AirPlay 在首页选接收设备。
entries.en: For a dashboard, join its Wi-Fi first and follow the connection card on the home screen. For CarLife, open CarLife on the head unit first. For AirPlay, select a receiver on the home screen.

entries.zh: 核对 iPhone 连的 Wi-Fi 和预设是否同名。仍连不上，关开一次 Wi-Fi，回到 App 重新启动。
entries.en: Check that the iPhone’s Wi-Fi network name matches the selected preset. If it still will not connect, turn Wi-Fi off and on, return to the app, and restart.

entries.zh: 网页打不开或没有画面
entries.en: Page Will Not Open or No Video

entries.zh: 先核对两台设备的 Wi-Fi 和首页地址。能打开但没画面时，先试 HTTP，再把画面设为 H.264、720P、30 帧。
entries.en: Check both devices’ Wi-Fi connections and the address on the home screen. If the page opens without video, try HTTP first, then set video to H.264, 720P, and 30 FPS.

entries.zh: 确认选对仪表型号、仪表已打开投屏，并在「输出设置」核对仪表 IP。先结束其他投屏。
entries.en: Check that the correct dashboard model is selected, screen projection is enabled on the dashboard, and the dashboard IP is correct under “Output Settings”. End any other screen projection sessions first.

entries.zh: 从 HTTP 接收页开始
entries.en: Start from the HTTP Receiver Page

entries.zh: 在接收设备上打开 HTTP 接收页，点「配置 HTTPS」，再按页面步骤为该设备安装证书。
entries.en: Open the HTTP receiver page on the receiving device, tap “Set Up HTTPS”, and follow the instructions to install a certificate on that device.

entries.zh: 下载描述文件后，在系统设置安装，再前往「通用 › 关于本机 › 证书信任设置」开启完全信任，最后打开 HTTPS 地址。
entries.en: After downloading the profile, install it in system Settings. Go to General › About › Certificate Trust Settings, enable full trust, then open the HTTPS address.

entries.zh: 下载 Android 证书，按接收页指引在系统设置中安装为 CA 证书，再打开 HTTPS 地址。系统菜单名称随品牌而异。
entries.en: Download the Android certificate and follow the receiver page’s instructions to install it as a CA certificate in system Settings. Then open the HTTPS address. Menu names vary by manufacturer.

entries.zh: 锁屏前，请在 iPhone「设置 › 通用 › CarPlay › CarWithin」中打开「锁定时允许 CarPlay」。后台运行会增加耗电。画中画仅显示实时画面。离开 App 时自动开启需打开 iPhone「设置 › 通用 › 画中画」中的自动选项。
entries.en: Before locking the iPhone, enable “Allow CarPlay While Locked” in Settings › General › CarPlay › CarWithin. Running in the background uses more battery. Picture in Picture shows live video only. To start it automatically when leaving the app, enable “Start PiP Automatically” in Settings › General › Picture in Picture.
Keep Running While Locked or in Background

entries.zh: 选择台铃输出时自动使用匹配的画面参数；切回其他输出后恢复原设置。
entries.en: Matching video settings are applied automatically for TAILG output. Your previous settings are restored when you switch to another output.

entries.zh: 启动时先用勾选的屏幕或最近一次设置。第一个网页接管后，窗口尺寸变化会在 CarWithin 回到前台时应用。更大的窗口按最高分辨率等比缩小。
entries.en: Startup uses the selected display or the most recent settings. After the first browser takes control, window size changes are applied when CarWithin returns to the foreground. Larger windows are scaled proportionally to fit the maximum resolution.

entries.zh: 选择比例后按分辨率档位计算尺寸，短边至少 320 像素，实际值见下方。2K/4K 会增加发热和带宽。
entries.en: The selected aspect ratio and resolution determine the video size, with a minimum short side of 320 pixels. See the actual size below. 2K/4K increases heat and bandwidth use.

entries.zh: 此输出受 1920×1080 限制，较长的竖屏比例以实际尺寸为准。
entries.en: This output is limited to 1920×1080. For tall portrait aspect ratios, refer to the actual size.

entries.zh: 自动帧率根据主网页选择 30 或 60 FPS。支持 H.265 的主网页会优先使用 H.265。
entries.en: Auto frame rate selects 30 or 60 FPS based on the primary browser. H.265 is preferred when the primary browser supports it.

entries.zh: 浏览器画面持续卡顿时，自动以更轻的画面重启 CarPlay（先降到 30 FPS，再降到 720P），每次连接最多两次。
entries.en: If browser video keeps stuttering, restart CarPlay automatically with lower video settings: first 30 FPS, then 720P. Limited to two restarts per connection.

entries.zh: 图标越小，一页放下的越多。可以在「车机屏幕」为不同屏幕保存图标大小。
entries.en: Smaller icons fit more items on a page. Save a different icon size for each display under “Head Unit Displays”.

entries.zh: 启动 CarPlay 后，在车机浏览器打开接收页，屏幕会自动记录在这里。
entries.en: After starting CarPlay, open the receiver page in the head unit’s browser. Its display will be recorded here automatically.

entries.zh: 启动时使用勾选的屏幕。左滑可删除。
entries.en: Startup uses the selected display. Swipe left to delete.

entries.zh: 设置会在下次使用这块屏幕时应用。
entries.en: These settings apply the next time you use this display.

entries.zh: 停止后即可修改声音输出。
entries.en: Stop CarPlay to change the audio output.

entries.zh: 更改在下次启动 CarPlay 时生效。使用 Wi-Fi 伴音时，通话和 Siri 留在 iPhone。
entries.en: Changes apply the next time CarPlay starts. With Wi-Fi audio, calls and Siri stay on the iPhone.

entries.zh: 打开局域网接收页后可使用 Wi-Fi 伴音。更改在下次启动 CarPlay 时生效。
entries.en: Wi-Fi audio is available through the local network receiver page. Changes apply the next time CarPlay starts.

entries.zh: 车辆名称显示在 iPhone 的 CarPlay 车辆列表中。
entries.en: The vehicle name appears in the iPhone’s CarPlay vehicle list.

entries.zh: 当前图标 · 自选图片
停止 CarPlay 后可更换图标。
entries.en: Stop CarPlay to change the icon.

entries.zh: 图片会居中裁成正方形，下次启动 CarPlay 时生效。
entries.en: The image is center-cropped to a square and takes effect the next time CarPlay starts.
Leave blank for an open network

entries.zh: 返回自动保存。同名网络会更新原预设，兼容信道通常保持 36。
entries.en: Changes are saved automatically when you go back. A network with the same name updates the existing preset. The compatibility channel can usually stay at 36.

entries.zh: 添加预设后，切换网络时可直接选用。
entries.en: Add a preset to quickly select it when switching networks.

entries.zh: 无法删除保存的密码，请重试。
entries.en: Cannot delete the saved password. Try again.

entries.zh: 轻点选用，左滑后确认删除。
entries.en: Tap to select. Swipe left and confirm to delete.

entries.zh: 让 iPhone 加入仪表 Wi-Fi，选择同名预设。结束其他投屏，打开仪表投屏后启动 CarPlay。声音由 iPhone 或蓝牙输出。
entries.en: Connect the iPhone to the dashboard’s Wi-Fi and select the matching preset. End other screen projection sessions, enable projection on the dashboard, then start CarPlay. Audio plays through the iPhone or Bluetooth.

entries.zh: iPhone 连上仪表 Wi-Fi，选择对应预设，先在 CarWithin 启动本机 CarPlay。没有画面时，保持 CarWithin 运行，再到九号出行开启投屏导航。
entries.en: Connect the iPhone to the dashboard’s Wi-Fi and select the matching preset. Start CarPlay on this iPhone in CarWithin first. If no video appears, keep CarWithin running and enable navigation projection in the Ninebot app.

entries.zh: 仪表出画后，可尝试从多任务界面划掉九号出行；若仪表随之退出投屏，则该型号需要保留官方会话。
entries.en: Once video appears on the dashboard, try swiping away the Ninebot app in the app switcher. If projection stops, this model requires the official app’s session to stay active.

entries.zh: 让九号出行留在后台。切换 App 前请打开「锁屏与后台继续运行」。
entries.en: Leave the Ninebot app running in the background. Enable “Keep Running While Locked or in Background” before switching apps.

entries.zh: 九号出行是否需要保留
entries.en: Does the Ninebot App Need to Stay Running?

entries.zh: 若提示 UDP 5012 被占用，先停止 CarWithin，退出九号出行投屏导航及其他投屏 App，再按上面的顺序重试。
entries.en: If UDP 5012 is in use, stop CarWithin, exit navigation projection in the Ninebot app, and close other screen projection apps. Then retry in the order above.

entries.zh: 在主界面的 AirPlay 连接卡选择设备。画面有缓冲，触控在 iPhone 上操作，声音沿用 iPhone 或车机蓝牙。
entries.en: Select a device in the AirPlay connection card on the home screen. Video is buffered; control it from the iPhone. Audio continues through the iPhone or the head unit’s Bluetooth.
Waiting for the Head Unit to Connect…

entries.zh: AirPlay 播放器：item={1} time={2} 外部视频={3} 路由={4} 等待={5} 错误={6}
entries.en: AirPlay player: item={1} time={2} externalVideo={3} route={4} waiting={5} error={6}

entries.zh: AirPlay 画面加载失败，可以重试。
entries.en: AirPlay video failed to load. Try again.

entries.zh: 正在通过 AirPlay 投放
画面已就绪，可选择设备。
适用于 TL-DASH-V2 仪表。iPhone 加入仪表 Wi-Fi，在「Wi-Fi 与网络」填写该网络信息；开启仪表投屏后启动 CarPlay。请先退出其他投屏 App。
entries.en: For TL-DASH-V2 dashboards. Connect the iPhone to the dashboard’s Wi-Fi and enter its network details under “Wi-Fi & Network”. Enable screen projection on the dashboard, then start CarPlay. Close other screen projection apps first.

entries.zh: 仪表输出固定为 480×272、JPEG，最高 20 FPS。本机 CarPlay 使用 H.264、960×544、30 FPS。声音由 iPhone／蓝牙输出；仪表不回传触控。
entries.en: Dashboard output is fixed at 480×272 JPEG, up to 20 FPS. CarPlay on this iPhone uses H.264 at 960×544 and 30 FPS. Audio plays through the iPhone or Bluetooth; the dashboard does not send touch input back.

entries.zh: 车机与 iPhone 连同一个 Wi-Fi，打开车机上的 CarLife 后启动 CarPlay。使用 H.264，最高 1080p、30 FPS。
entries.en: Connect the head unit and iPhone to the same Wi-Fi network. Open CarLife on the head unit, then start CarPlay. Uses H.264 at up to 1080p and 30 FPS.

entries.zh: CarLife 传输画面和触控，声音走 iPhone 与车机的蓝牙。
entries.en: CarLife carries video and touch input. Audio uses Bluetooth between the iPhone and head unit.

entries.zh: 开启后，同一局域网的浏览器可以查看并触控 CarPlay。
entries.en: When enabled, browsers on the same local network can view and control CarPlay.

entries.zh: 启动后就可以在本机浏览器查看画面。
entries.en: Start CarPlay to view video in this device’s browser.

entries.zh: 浏览器性能默认自动。低延迟频繁跳帧时会回到兼容模式。
entries.en: Browser performance defaults to Auto. Low-latency playback falls back to compatibility mode if it repeatedly skips frames.

entries.zh: 域名格式应为 name.duckdns.org，不包含协议或端口。
entries.en: Use a domain such as name.duckdns.org, without a protocol or port.

entries.zh: 配置已保存，停止并重新启动 CarPlay 后使用新证书或地址。
entries.en: Configuration saved. Stop and restart CarPlay to use the new certificate or address.

entries.zh: 无法安全保存 Token，请重试。
entries.en: Cannot securely save the token. Try again.

entries.zh: 本地 IP 和 sslip.io 使用这台设备的本地根证书。DuckDNS 可使用自行申请的公开 CA 证书。
entries.en: Local IP and sslip.io use this device’s local root certificate. DuckDNS can use a public CA certificate that you obtain separately.

entries.zh: 在接收设备的 HTTP 页面点「配置 HTTPS」，安装并信任本机根证书。
entries.en: On the receiving device’s HTTP page, tap “Set Up HTTPS” to install and trust this device’s root certificate.

entries.zh: 地址根据手机当前 IP 自动生成，无需账号；DNS 解析需要网络。仍需在接收设备信任本机根证书。只改变域名，不保证绕过特斯拉的私网限制。
entries.en: The address is generated from the phone’s current IP; no account is needed. DNS resolution requires network access. You must still trust this device’s root certificate on the receiver. This only changes the domain name and does not guarantee bypassing Tesla’s private network restrictions.

entries.zh: 先在 duckdns.org 注册自己的域名。Token 可修改账号中的域名，请像密码一样保管；仅保存在本机 Keychain。此处将域名指向当前局域网地址，不开放公网端口。
entries.en: Register your own domain at duckdns.org first. The token can modify domains in your account, so keep it secure like a password. It is stored only in this device’s Keychain. This points the domain to the current local network address and does not open any public ports.

entries.zh: 使用 ACME DNS-01 等方式在外部申请该域名的公开证书，导出包含私钥与完整证书链的 P12 后导入。当前不自动签发或续期；到期后需重新导入。仅在本机受信任不能保证车机信任；域名和证书也不能保证绕过车机的私网限制。
entries.en: Obtain a public certificate for this domain externally, for example using ACME DNS-01. Export a P12 containing the private key and full certificate chain, then import it. Automatic issuance and renewal are not supported; import a new certificate when it expires. Trust on this device does not guarantee trust on the head unit. Neither the domain nor the certificate guarantees bypassing the head unit’s private network restrictions.

entries.zh: 请先停止 CarPlay，并连接 Wi-Fi。
entries.en: Stop CarPlay and connect to Wi-Fi first.

entries.zh: 解析已更新到 {1}，DNS 缓存生效可能需要稍等。
entries.en: DNS updated to {1}. Cached DNS records may take time to refresh.

entries.zh: 最近 200 条，不含 Wi-Fi 密码和 MFi 私钥。
entries.en: The latest 200 entries. Wi-Fi passwords and MFi private keys are excluded.

entries.zh: 检查这台 iPhone 是否允许 App 发布本机 iAP2 配件端点（本机 CarPlay 的前提）。CarPlay 运行中不能测试。
entries.en: Check whether this iPhone allows the app to publish a local iAP2 accessory endpoint, which is required for CarPlay on this iPhone. Stop CarPlay before testing.

entries.zh: 接收其他 iPhone 的 CarPlay，或把这台设备的 CarPlay 投送到另一台 iPad。
entries.en: Receive CarPlay from another iPhone, or send this device’s CarPlay to another iPad.

entries.zh: 用蓝牙通知 iPhone 连接这块接收屏。
entries.en: Use Bluetooth to ask the iPhone to connect to this receiver.

entries.zh: 在 iPhone 上启动 CarPlay，通过浏览器或兼容的 CarLife 车机查看和操控。
entries.en: Start CarPlay on your iPhone, then view and control it in a browser or on a compatible CarLife head unit.

entries.zh: 请选择不超过 512 KB 的 P12 证书。
entries.en: Choose a P12 certificate no larger than 512 KB.

entries.zh: 密码与证书仅保存在本机 Keychain。
entries.en: The password and certificate are stored only in this device’s Keychain.

entries.zh: 证书通过本机域名、有效期和信任校验，重新启动 CarPlay 后生效。
entries.en: The certificate passed local domain, validity, and trust checks. Restart CarPlay to apply it.

entries.zh: 请选择另一张照片再试。
entries.en: Choose another photo and try again.
